models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest identities for unauthenticated visitors.

Represents an anonymous visitor identified by device fingerprint before authentication. Each guest identity is created when a person first visits the application, providing a persistent but anonymous reference for tracking session activity during signup and login flows. Once the visitor authenticates, they transition to a {@link todo_app_members} identity.

Guest identities are ephemeral by nature — the system does not retain guest information across extended periods without activity.

plainFields.name: fingerprint
plainFields.description:
Device fingerprint hash uniquely identifying the guest.

A hashed representation of the visitor's device characteristics, used to recognize returning unauthenticated visitors across visits. Must be unique across all guest records to prevent duplicate identities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest identity was first recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest identity record was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access during signup and login flows.

Each session belongs to a single {@link todo_app_guests} record and tracks the IP address, current page URL (href), and referrer URL for security auditing. Sessions are append-only and managed through authentication flows. When a guest completes signup or login, the guest transitions to member and the guest session is superseded by a member session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the guest identity that this session belongs to.

Establishes a 1:N relationship where one {@link todo_app_guests} can have multiple sessions over time.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
IP address of the guest at the time of session creation.

Used for security auditing and anomaly detection across sessions.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
Current page URL where the guest was located when the session was created.

Captures the entry point context for the signup or login flow.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
Referrer URL indicating the previous page the guest navigated from.

Provides additional context for traffic source analysis and security auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session was created.

Marks the beginning of the guest's temporary authentication context.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session expires.

After this point the session is no longer valid and the guest must re-authenticate. Defaults to NOT NULL for security, ensuring every session has a finite lifetime.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email-based authentication, password credentials, and personal display name.

{@link todo_app_member_sessions} track authenticated login sessions for each member. {User Concept} defines the email as the unique identity credential — no two members share the same email. The display name is a personal label visible only to the member themselves, with no uniqueness constraint across members.

When a member changes their password, all active sessions are ended immediately. Account deletion permanently removes the member and cascades to all owned {@link todo_app_todos} and their {@link todo_app_edit_histories}, as well as ending all active sessions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description:
Unique email address serving as the member's primary identity credential for login.

Must be a valid email format. This is the canonical identifier for authentication — members log in using their email and password combination. Uniqueness is enforced at the database level.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description:
Cryptographic hash of the member's password credential.

Stored using a secure one-way hashing algorithm (bcrypt/argon2). The raw password is never stored. Password changes replace this value and invalidate all active sessions for the account.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description:
Personal label chosen by the member to represent themselves within their own workspace.

Unlike email, the display name does not need to be unique across members. It is visible only to the owning member — cross-user visibility is prohibited. Members can edit their display name at any time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the member account was created (registration completed).

Set automatically at account creation and never changes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp of the most recent modification to the member's account record.

Updated automatically when fields such as display_name or password_hash are changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the member account was deleted.

Account deletion is permanent in this system — the member and all associated data are physically removed, and all active sessions are ended immediately. This field supports the standard soft-delete temporal pattern for potential recovery windows.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

Records each authenticated login session for {@link todo_app_members}, capturing the client's network context and the session's temporal bounds. Each session is append-only and serves as an audit trail for member authentication activity.

Sessions are created upon successful login or registration and remain valid until their expiration timestamp. The system enforces session expiry through the expired_at field — sessions past this timestamp are considered terminated and cannot be used for authentication.

Each session is tied to exactly one member. A member may have multiple concurrent sessions across different devices or browsers, each tracked independently.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
References the authenticated {@link todo_app_members} who owns this session.

Establishes the ownership chain for session validation — every authenticated request must match a valid, non-expired session linked to the requesting member.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
Client IP address at the time of session creation.

Captured from the request context during login or registration. Provides audit trail information for security analysis and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
Request URL path at the time of session creation.

Records the endpoint or page that initiated the session. Provides context for audit and debugging purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
HTTP Referer header value at the time of session creation.

Captures the referring page or source that led to the authentication request. May be empty for direct navigation or API clients.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session was created.

Set at the moment of successful authentication. Forms part of the composite index with {@link todo_app_member_id} for efficient chronological session listing.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

Sessions past this timestamp are considered terminated. Set to NOT NULL by default for security — every session must have a finite lifetime. The application layer enforces expiry checks against this field during request authentication.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for member password recovery.

Stores time-limited, cryptographically secure tokens issued when a {@link todo_app_members} requests a password reset. Each token is globally unique to prevent collisions and is consumed (hard-deleted) upon successful password change or expired cleanup.

A member may have multiple active reset tokens concurrently — for instance, if they request multiple resets before completing one. Tokens become invalid after their expiration timestamp and must be rejected by the system.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the {@link todo_app_members} account that requested the password reset.

Establishes a many-to-one relationship: a member may have multiple reset tokens issued over time, but each token belongs to exactly one member account.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description:
Cryptographically secure random token used to verify the reset request.

This token is delivered to the member (e.g., via email) and must be presented back to authorize the password change. Globally unique to prevent any possibility of collision between concurrent or successive reset requests.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp after which this reset token becomes invalid.

Once this point in time passes, the token must not be accepted for password change operations. The system should reject any reset attempt using an expired token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this reset token was generated and issued.

Records the moment the member initiated the password reset request.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp of the last modification to this reset token record.

Updated if the token's expiration is extended or any metadata changes occur.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Individual task items belonging to authenticated members with title, optional description, optional start and due dates, completion status, soft-delete lifecycle, and creation timestamp.

Each todo belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_members member}. Todos are completely private — members can only access their own todos. Newly created todos default to incomplete. Members can toggle completion status freely between incomplete and complete, edit any attribute (each edit recorded in {@link todo_app_edit_histories}), soft-delete (moving to trash), restore from trash, or permanently delete.

**Completion Status**: Tracked via the `completed_at` timestamp — NULL indicates incomplete, a non-NULL value indicates the todo is complete and records when it was marked complete. Toggling back to incomplete clears this field.

**Soft-Delete Lifecycle**: The `deleted_at` field drives the trash workflow. When NULL, the todo is active and appears in the normal todo list. When set, the todo is in trash — hidden from the active list and visible only in the dedicated trash view. Restoring clears `deleted_at`; permanent deletion removes the row entirely along with all associated {@link todo_app_edit_histories}.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the {@link todo_app_members member} who owns this todo.

Every todo is scoped to exactly one member. The member has full ownership — they alone can view, edit, toggle, soft-delete, restore, and permanently delete this todo. No cross-member access exists.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short text describing the task. Required — a todo cannot exist without a title.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Longer text providing additional detail about the task. Optional — may be left empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
The date when work on the task is intended to begin. Optional — may be left unset.

When both this and `due_date` are set, the service layer enforces that `due_date` must not be earlier than `start_date`.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
The date by which the task should be completed. Optional — may be left unset.

When both this and `start_date` are set, the service layer enforces that `due_date` must not be earlier than `start_date`.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description:
Records when the todo was marked complete. NULL means the todo is incomplete; a non-NULL timestamp means the todo is complete and captures the exact completion time.

Defaults to NULL (incomplete) on creation. Toggling between states sets this to the current timestamp (complete) or clears it to NULL (incomplete).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo was first created. Set automatically on creation and never changes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo was last modified. Updated automatically on any attribute change including completion toggles and soft-delete/restore operations.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft-delete timestamp. NULL indicates the todo is active; a non-NULL value indicates the todo has been moved to the trash.

Active todos appear in the normal todo list. Trashed todos are hidden from the active list and visible only via the trash view. Restoring from trash sets this back to NULL.

models.name: todo_app_edit_histories
models.description:
Immutable audit trail recording field-level snapshots of a {@link todo_app_todos} after each edit.

Each entry captures the complete state of the todo's editable fields — title, description, start date, and due date — at the moment the edit was applied. Entries are append-only: once created, they cannot be modified or individually deleted. The only removal path is cascade deletion when the parent todo is permanently deleted from the trash.

Edit histories are presented to the user in reverse chronological order (most recent first), supported by the composite index on parent todo and creation timestamp.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the parent {@link todo_app_todos} whose edit produced this history entry.

Establishes the 1:N relationship where a todo can accumulate many edit history entries over its lifetime. Deletion is cascaded: when the parent todo is permanently deleted from the trash, all associated edit history entries are removed along with it.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description:
The title of the todo after the edit was applied.

Always populated because every todo must have a title per business rules.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
The description of the todo after the edit was applied.

Nullable because the description field on the parent todo is optional and may be left empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
The start date of the todo after the edit was applied.

Nullable because the start date field on the parent todo is optional and may be left unset.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
The due date of the todo after the edit was applied.

Nullable because the due date field on the parent todo is optional and may be left unset.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this edit history entry was created, representing the date and time the edit occurred.

Set automatically at creation and never changes. Serves as both the record's creation timestamp and the edit timestamp visible to the user in the history listing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp of the last update to this record.

Set to the same value as created_at at creation time. Since edit history entries are immutable and never modified after creation, this value remains unchanged.
